## Fourth Global Coral Bleaching Event Sets a Record for Heat-Stress Exposure

The fourth global coral bleaching event was confirmed on April 15, 2024. Satellite data tracked bleaching-level heat stress across roughly 84.4% of global reef area from January 2023 through September 2025—a measurement period that began before the event’s confirmation and continued afterward.

Mass bleaching was documented in at least 83 countries and territories. The measured heat-stress footprint exceeded the 68.2% recorded during the 2014–2017 event, making this event record-setting by area exposed to bleaching-level heat stress.

That exposure figure does not mean every reef in the footprint bleached or died. It measures heat stress, not verified bleaching or mortality across all exposed reefs.
